page.overview:
Who is Affpuddle of the Cheerful Countenance?

Sir Affpuddle of the Cheerful Countenance was a wizard and a friendly knight who won every battle before it was fought through his amiable negotiating tactics.

He was regarded as "the friendliest knight", and had a statue built in the Bell Towers at Hogwarts Castle in his honour, which would wave at those who approached. Some attributed his success to Cheering Charms.

Sir Affpuddle's kindness was his undoing as he died instantly while attempting to befriend a basilisk. He was so universally well-liked that even some goblins mourned his passing — which did not go well with the rest of the goblins, most of whom could not abide mourning the loss of a wizard.
